safe_test_strategy: Use an explicitly authorized callback and existing SSRF engine.
expected_behavior: User input must not cause unauthorized server-side requests.

potential_false_positives.scenario: Public, cached, reflected or synthetic content resembles a protected result.
potential_false_positives.mitigation: Verify the resource policy, distinct identities, provenance and negative controls before confirming.

confirmation_criteria: Unique correlated server-side callback with browser and scanner traffic excluded.
